entries.title: Show HN: I made an app that consolidated 18 apps (doc, sheet, form, site, chat…)
entries.author: harrisonlo
entries.current_title: Show HN: I made an app that consolidated 18 apps (doc, sheet, form, site, chat…)
entries.excerpt: Nino is a radical approach to solve the app chaos problem for today's knowledge worker. I believe there are still too many tools; even using them becomes work in itself. I'm building all these apps from scratch in one place, using the same database and UI, with the flexibility to eventually support the majority of work from one "superapp." Currently there are 18 apps (called "modules") on Nino: - Database types: Sheet, Form, Calendar, Gallery, Board, Todo, List - Composition
entries.guide_zh: Nino 把文档、表格、表单与聊天等十八种应用整合到统一界面和数据库。

entries.title: Show HN: I made a HTMX Playground 100% in the browser
entries.author: bitterblotter
entries.current_title: Show HN: I made a HTMX Playground 100% in the browser
entries.excerpt: I recently dug up an old project in an attempt to improve on it. It's a code sandbox for playing around with HTMX in the browser, that runs a mock server within the sandbox iframe. The server "framework" is loosely based on Django, so if you're familiar with Django, you'll immediately understand what's going on. I recommend clicking through the examples. entries.guide_zh: 完全在浏览器中运行 HTMX 沙盒，并用模拟服务器响应请求。
